findings.message: The unparsable-JSON fix covers only the case where jq exits non-zero. If kubectl exits 0 with empty stdout, jq prints nothing and exits 0, so `codex_slot_state` returns an empty string. `claim_codex_slot` has no case for an empty state, so it proceeds as if the slot were free. The same goes for any caller that treats an unknown state as free. Reject empty or unknown output explicitly, for example `s=$(jq ...) || s=''; [[ -n $s ]] || s='error unparsable Job JSON'`, or add a `*) die` default branch. A `finished null` result (no `.metadata.uid`) should also be an error. The fix also ships with no test that feeds the stub unparsable, empty or non-object Job JSON.
findings.scenario: The kubectl stub returns exit 0 with an empty body for `get job fleet-codex-<hash>`. `codex_slot_state` prints nothing, `claim_codex_slot` matches no case, and a second codex Job is created while the first may still be active. Concurrency on the codex slot is then not enforced.

findings.message: The new write-before-gate rows assert only the exit code and message through `gate`. They do not assert that no `azdo-issue untag`, `azdo-issue create`, `fields`, `tag`, `claim` or `pipelines run` call reached `$CALLS`. Reverting the reorder would still return the same rc and message while writing first, so the rows do not fail without the fix. Every row also passes `--retry` or `--create` against a change that is merely unapproved or lacks consent. There is no row for a change carrying the `fleet:refused` tag, which is where untag matters. There is no `--create` row where the work item is missing and a later gate fails, such as a missing credential. Add those rows and assert that `$CALLS` holds no write command. The ac18 detector now matches `untag|create`, but its `row()` runs `trigger` without `--retry` or `--create`, so that widening exercises nothing.
findings.scenario: A refactor moves `azdo-issue untag` back before the consent gate. `trigger --retry` on a refused change with a non-assignee `fleet:auto` still exits 4 with the expected message, but the refused tag has already been removed. All new rows stay green.

findings.message: The diff changes plugin code under plugins/specclaw-fleet but bumps no version, and the branch commits since 'chore: bump version to 0.8.9' (r2–r5) show no bump either. Bump every plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, every plugins/*/.codex-plugin/plugin.json and every plugins[] entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json to one new identical version.
findings.scenario: The PR merges with all manifests still at 0.8.9 while fleet code has changed. Installed users get no update signal.
